data.title: 罗丝薇瑟 · 晨曦厨房的围裙私语
data.description: 清晨明媚的公寓厨房内飘着味噌汤与烤鱼的香气。罗丝薇瑟系着特价买来的绿色棉麻围裙，内衬是简单的浅灰无袖背心。她单手拿着尝味木勺，转过身来向你展示煮好的早餐，泛红的双颊带着初为人妇般的温柔娇羞，认真叮嘱着今天也要好好吃饱出门。
data.action: standing in bright sunny kitchen holding tasting spoon, apron over casual sleeveless top, bare arms and collarbones, hair tied in loose morning bun, blushing domestic smile
data.lighting: cheerful morning sunlight flooding through kitchen window
data.mood: thrifty devoted wife charm, heart-warming morning domesticity
data.promptProse: Standing in a bright morning kitchen holding a cooking spoon, Rossweisse wears a neat apron over a sleeveless top. Sunbeams highlight her silver hair tied in a loose bun as she smiles warmly with an affectionate blush.
data.animaCaption: Rossweisse in an apron tasting soup in a sunlit kitchen, smiling with sweet domestic warmth.
